note: Small City of Lamar RV area on the west side of Lamar City Park. No tent camping at any city facility, and no overnight camping at Lamar City Lake. --Claude
summary: City FAQ confirms 3 electric hookups, first night free then $20, 7-night max, shared fill hydrant + central dump; potable water added; note trimmed. Amperage, booking method and pad lengths not stated. Pin not confirmed on imagery.
flags: BOOKING (left as derived): the FAQ says nothing about reservations or first-come; the stored reservable false / fcfs always come from the old note, and max_stay_nights 7 matches the FAQ. Parks & Recreation Office 417-682-5851 (stored phone, and Google's) would know.
FIT: the FAQ gives no pad lengths and the three hookups could not be picked out on imagery; a city-park RV pad is likely to take a 23-ft rig, but nothing read says so.

PIN: stored 37.4860,-94.2810 is at the north edge of the park beside the pool, by the rail line; Google's listing point 37.4844,-94.2827 is mid-park. The FAQ puts the RV area on the park's 'west side' with the dump on its 'southwest edge'; I could not identify the three hookups on imagery (Overpass timed out), so no corrected pin is offered.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept; a small creek runs through the park and Lamar City Lake (no camping) lies at the west edge, but the RV area could not be placed against either.
Google Maps (park listing): 4.6 stars (449 reviews) - for the whole city park, not the RV area.
